BriefActions: briefactions.svg reproduces the app's existing mark and original
#0084C7 color from briefactions/web/public/flow.svg, also used as two ribbon
paths in briefactions/web/src/ProductBrand.jsx. Source clone commit f82ff4f.

TaskBoard: the source app currently uses text initials "TB" in the landing and
sidebar components, with no separate logo asset found in frontend/. Source
clone commit 4681082. taskboard-pictogram.svg is a new portfolio illustration
of a board and tickets, not an existing official TaskBoard brand mark.

orbit.js draws these same SVG paths directly into its local lens canvas,
retaining project names below the symbols and avoiding asynchronous loads.
